articles.title: Indian Left struggles electorally despite rising popularity among young student leaders

articles.title: At least 17 killed in stampede at religious gathering in India
articles.summary: A “stampede” during a Hindu religious festival in eastern India has killed at least 17 people and injured 25, officials said. A seven-year-old girl was among the fatalities in Saturday’s disaster in north Kolkata in West Bengal, the state’s Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari told reporters. “Six bodies have so far been identified,” Adhikari said.

articles.title: Federal Bank appoints Cognizant India CMD Rajesh Varrier as independent director
articles.summary: The board, at its meeting held on Friday, approved the appointment of Rajesh Varrier as an additional director (non-executive independent director) for a period of three years with effect from October 16, 2026, Federal Bank said in a regulatory filing. Varrier is not related to any of the directors of the bank, it said.

articles.title: Himachal Pradesh opposition warns government over new administrative blocks
articles.summary: Leader of the opposition Jai Ram Thakur stated on Saturday that the Bharatiya Janata Party government will review new administrative blocks created by the Congress government if they were formed for political gains. Speaking in Himachal Pradesh, Thakur warned that any decisions made against public sentiment would face scrutiny after the two thousand twenty-seven elections.

articles.title: Asian Para Games opening ceremony: When and where to watch live in India, time
articles.summary: The Asian Para Games 2026 will begin with an opening ceremony in Nagoya, Japan, on Sunday, October 18. India will be represented by para badminton star Pramod Bhagat and sprinter Simran Sharma as its flag-bearers, after Sharma replaced table tennis player Bhavina Patel to allow her more time to rest ahead of her quarter-final on October 19.

articles.summary_hi: एशियाई पैरा गेम्स 2026 रविवार, 18 अक्टूबर को जापान के नागोया में एक उद्घाटन समारोह के साथ शुरू होंगे। भारत का प्रतिनिधित्व पैरा बैडमिंटन स्टार प्रमोद भगत और धावक सिमरन शर्मा करेंगे, क्योंकि शर्मा ने टेबल टेनिस खिलाड़ी भाविना पटेल की जगह ली है, जिससे उन्हें 19 अक्टूबर को अपने क्वार्टर फाइनल से पहले आराम करने के लिए अधिक समय मिलेगा।
articles.title_hinglish: eshiyaee paira khelon ka udghatana samaroh: bharata men kaba aura kahan laiva dekhen, samaya
articles.summary_hinglish: eshiyaee paira gemsa 2026 ravivar, 18 aktubara ko japana ke nagoya men eka udghatana samaroha ke satha shuru honge। bharata ka pratinidhitva paira baidamintana stara pramoda bhagata aura dhavaka simarana sharma karenge, kyonki sharma ne tebala tenisa khiladaी bhavina patela ki jagaha li hai, jisase unhen 19 aktubara ko apane kvartara phainala se pahale aarama karane ke lie adhika samaya milega।

articles.title: Rajasthan BJP makes local poll gains, Congress fails to contain infighting
articles.summary: Despite internal conflicts among the senior state leaders, the BJP has been able to showcase unity with leaders standing behind CM Bhajan Lal Sharma. In Congress every leader is talking about unity but the differences keep surfacing. Recently while a group of Tribal leaders joining the party at Gehlot's residence raised slogans about 'Gehlot as CM for fourth time'.
articles.title_hi: राजस्थान में भाजपा को स्थानीय चुनावों में बढ़त, कांग्रेस अंदरूनी कलह रोकने में विफल
articles.summary_hi: राज्य के वरिष्ठ नेताओं के बीच आंतरिक संघर्ष के बावजूद, भाजपा सीएम भजन लाल शर्मा के पीछे खड़े नेताओं के साथ एकता दिखाने में सक्षम है। कांग्रेस में हर नेता एकजुटता की बात कर रहा है लेकिन मतभेद सामने आते रहते हैं. हाल ही में आदिवासी नेताओं के एक समूह ने जब गहलोत के आवास पर पार्टी में शामिल होते हुए 'गहलोत चौथी बार सीएम होंगे' के नारे लगाए थे.
articles.title_hinglish: rajasthana men bhajapa ko sthaniya chunavon men badhat, kangresa andaruni kalaha rokane men viphala
articles.summary_hinglish: rajya ke varishtha netaon ke bicha aantarika sangharsha ke bavajud, bhajapa siema bhajana lala sharma ke pichhe khadaे netaon ke satha ekata dikhane men sakshama hai। kangresa men hara neta ekajutata ki bata kara raha hai lekina matabheda samane aate rahate hain. hala hi men aadivasi netaon ke eka samuha ne jaba gahalota ke aavasa para parti men shamila hote hue 'gahalota chauthi bara siema honge' ke nare lagae the.

articles.summary: File. | Photo Credit: ANI West Bengal Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) president and Rajya Sabha MP Samik Bhattacharya on Saturday (October 17, 2026) called for a fresh special intensive revision (SIR) of the electoral rolls in the State, amidst protests raging across the country demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar and scrapping of the SIR exercise.

articles.summary_hinglish: phaाil. | photo sabhar: ANI pashchima bangala bharatiya janata parti (bhajapa) ke adhyaksha aura rajyasabha sansada samika bhattacharya ne shanivara (17 aktubar, 2026) ko mukhya chunava aayukta (sieesi) jnyanesha kumara ke istiphe aura esaaaeeaara abhyasa ko khatma karane ki manga ko lekara desha bhara men chala rahe virodha pradarshanon ke bicha rajya men matadata suchi ke nae vishesha gahana punarikshana (esaaaeeaara) ka aahvana kiya।

articles.title: CM Omar Abdullah Thanks PM Modi for Rs 475.41 Crore ITI Upgrade Plans
articles.summary: SRINAGAR : Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah has thanked Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Union Minister for Skill Development and Entrepreneurship Jayant Singh for approving Strategic Investment Plans worth Rs 475. 41 crore to upgrade Industrial Training Institute (ITI) clusters in the Union Territory under the PM-SETU initiative.

articles.title: Kerala High Court refuses stay on Waqf Board reconstitution under Mayin Haji
articles.summary: The Kerala High Court on Saturday refused to stay the reconstitution. The government issued an order on Friday dissolving the board headed by K S Hamsa and appointing a new nine-member committee. The previous LDF government had constituted Hamsa's board in March, and more than four years of its tenure remained.

articles.title_hinglish: enaechabi ke purva adhyaksha raja vikasa varma ka 72 varsha ki umra men nidhan; bandhaka garanti ka bidaा uthaya
articles.summary_hinglish: varma ne rashtriya aavasa bainka ke adhyaksha ke rupa men karya kiya aura isa kshetra men kaee pramukha pahalon ki dekharekha ki। unake kama ne bandhaka-samarthita pratibhutikarana aura kiphayati aavasa karyakramon ki ninva rakhi। bharatiya vittiya kshetra ke pratishthita net, korporeta nideshaka aura neshanala hausinga bainka ke purva adhyaksha raja vikasa varma ka shukravara ko 72 varsha ki aayu men nidhana ho gaya।

articles.title: Who is Kavya Maran? Sunrisers Hyderabad CEO set to marry ‘Jailer 2’ composer Anirudh
articles.summary: Star composer Anirudh Ravichander who is basking in the success of Rajinikanth’s ‘Jailer 2’ will be getting married to Kavya Maran daughter of Indian billionaire media proprietor Kalanithi Maran. The couple is planning to tie the knot in November, with their wedding reception scheduled to take place in Chennai on November 21.

articles.title: Bihar Police To Digitally Map Boundaries Of Every Police Station, Track Crime Hotspots
articles.summary: Patna : Bihar Police is developing a Geographic Information System (GIS)-based portal to digitally map the boundaries of police stations across the state , aiming to reduce jurisdiction disputes and improve coordination during investigations and emergency responses. The proposed portal will allow police officials to identify which police station has jurisdiction over a particular location.
articles.title_hi: बिहार पुलिस हर पुलिस स्टेशन की सीमाओं का डिजिटल नक्शा तैयार करेगी, अपराध के हॉटस्पॉट पर नजर रखेगी
articles.summary_hi: पटना : बिहार पुलिस राज्य भर के पुलिस स्टेशनों की सीमाओं को डिजिटल रूप से मैप करने के लिए एक भौगोलिक सूचना प्रणाली (जीआईएस) आधारित पोर्टल विकसित कर रही है, जिसका उद्देश्य क्षेत्राधिकार विवादों को कम करना और जांच और आपातकालीन प्रतिक्रियाओं के दौरान समन्वय में सुधार करना है। प्रस्तावित पोर्टल पुलिस अधिकारियों को यह पहचानने की अनुमति देगा कि किसी विशेष स्थान पर किस पुलिस स्टेशन का अधिकार क्षेत्र है।
articles.title_hinglish: bihara pulisa hara pulisa steshana ki simaon ka dijitala naksha taiyara karegi, aparadha ke hotaspota para najara rakhegi
articles.summary_hinglish: patana : bihara pulisa rajya bhara ke pulisa steshanon ki simaon ko dijitala rupa se maipa karane ke lie eka bhaugolika suchana pranali (jiaaeeesa) aadharita portala vikasita kara rahi hai, jisaka uddeshya kshetradhikara vivadon ko kama karana aura jancha aura aapatakalina pratikriyaon ke daurana samanvaya men sudhara karana hai। prastavita portala pulisa adhikariyon ko yaha pahachanane ki anumati dega ki kisi vishesha sthana para kisa pulisa steshana ka adhikara kshetra hai।

articles.title: CJI Surya Kant urges NLSIU graduates to uphold ethics, defend justice and constitutional
articles.summary: Chief Justice of India (CJI) and Chancellor of the National Law School of India University (NLSIU), Justice Surya Kant, on Saturday said that “unexpected and unfortunate circumstances” driven by “certain external forces” had created uncertainty over the 34th annual convocation, adding that for a while, it seemed the occasion might not take place as hoped.

articles.title: YOUNG TENNIS TALENT TAKES CENTRE STAGE IN CHANDIGARH
articles.summary: Ms. Prerna Puri, IAS, Secretary Sports, Chandigarh Administration, graced the inaugural ceremony as the Chief Guest. She interacted with the participating players, encouraged them to strive for excellence and emphasised the importance of discipline, dedication and sportsmanship in achieving success. She also played the opening shot, formally inaugurating the championship.
articles.title_hi: चंडीगढ़ में युवा टेनिस प्रतिभा का केंद्र बिंदु है
articles.summary_hi: सुश्री प्रेरणा पुरी, आईएएस, सचिव खेल, चंडीगढ़ प्रशासन, मुख्य अतिथि के रूप में उद्घाटन समारोह में शामिल हुईं। उन्होंने भाग लेने वाले खिलाड़ियों के साथ बातचीत की, उन्हें उत्कृष्टता के लिए प्रयास करने के लिए प्रोत्साहित किया और सफलता प्राप्त करने में अनुशासन, समर्पण और खेल कौशल के महत्व पर जोर दिया। उन्होंने चैंपियनशिप का औपचारिक उद्घाटन करते हुए शुरुआती शॉट भी खेला।
articles.title_hinglish: chandigadha men yuva tenisa pratibha ka kendra bindu hai
articles.summary_hinglish: sushri prerana puri, aaeeees, sachiva khel, chandigadha prashasan, mukhya atithi ke rupa men udghatana samaroha men shamila hueen। unhonne bhaga lene vale khiladaिyon ke satha batachita ki, unhen utkrishtata ke lie prayasa karane ke lie protsahita kiya aura saphalata prapta karane men anushasan, samarpana aura khela kaushala ke mahatva para jora diya। unhonne chainpiyanashipa ka aupacharika udghatana karate hue shuruaati shota bhi khela।

articles.title: Indian IT stocks record best week in 18 years amid global AI sell-off
articles.summary: 72 per cent, as a global sell-off in AI-linked equities redirected investor focus towards India's robust and domestically supported information technology services sector. A JP Morgan report called India the natural artificial intelligence (AI) hedge based on the premise that the market is large, liquid and has big domestic institutional investors that keep it ticking without depending on foreign capital.
articles.title_hi: वैश्विक एआई बिकवाली के बीच भारतीय आईटी शेयरों ने 18 साल में सबसे अच्छा सप्ताह दर्ज किया
articles.summary_hi: 72 प्रतिशत, एआई-लिंक्ड इक्विटी में वैश्विक बिकवाली के कारण निवेशकों का ध्यान भारत के मजबूत और घरेलू स्तर पर समर्थित सूचना प्रौद्योगिकी सेवा क्षेत्र की ओर गया। जेपी मॉर्गन की एक रिपोर्ट में भारत को प्राकृतिक कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता (एआई) हेज कहा गया है, इस आधार पर कि बाजार बड़ा है, तरल है और इसमें बड़े घरेलू संस्थागत निवेशक हैं जो विदेशी पूंजी पर निर्भर हुए बिना इसे टिकते रहते हैं।
articles.title_hinglish: vaishvika eaaee bikavali ke bicha bharatiya aaeeti sheyaron ne 18 sala men sabase achchha saptaha darja kiya
articles.summary_hinglish: 72 pratishat, eaaee-linkda ikviti men vaishvika bikavali ke karana niveshakon ka dhyana bharata ke majabuta aura gharelu stara para samarthita suchana praudyogiki seva kshetra ki ora gaya। jepi morgana ki eka riporta men bharata ko prakritika kritrima buddhimatta (eaaee) heja kaha gaya hai, isa aadhara para ki bajara badaा hai, tarala hai aura isamen badaे gharelu sansthagata niveshaka hain jo videshi punji para nirbhara hue bina ise tikate rahate hain।

articles.title: Rare Apple-1 computer with letter from Steve Jobs, Steve Wozniak signature sells
articles.summary: An exceptionally rare, fully operational Apple-1 computer has sold at auction for $1. 15 million – setting a new world-record price for a commercially released model of the machine that started Apple. The sale concluded after an intense, 28-minute bidding battle between two collectors, with the PC crossing the auction block during Apple's 50th anniversary year.
articles.title_hi: स्टीव जॉब्स के पत्र, स्टीव वोज्नियाक के हस्ताक्षर वाला दुर्लभ Apple-1 कंप्यूटर बिकता है
articles.summary_hi: एक असाधारण दुर्लभ, पूरी तरह से चालू होने वाला Apple-1 कंप्यूटर नीलामी में $1 में बिका है। 15 मिलियन - Apple द्वारा शुरू की गई मशीन के व्यावसायिक रूप से जारी मॉडल के लिए एक नया विश्व-रिकॉर्ड मूल्य स्थापित करना। बिक्री दो संग्राहकों के बीच 28 मिनट की गहन बोली लड़ाई के बाद संपन्न हुई, जिसमें पीसी ने ऐप्पल की 50वीं वर्षगांठ वर्ष के दौरान नीलामी ब्लॉक को पार कर लिया।
articles.title_hinglish: stiva jobsa ke patr, stiva vojniyaka ke hastakshara vala durlabha Apple-1 kanpyutara bikata hai
articles.summary_hinglish: eka asadharana durlabh, puri taraha se chalu hone vala Apple-1 kanpyutara nilami men $1 men bika hai। 15 miliyana - Apple dvara shuru ki gaee mashina ke vyavasayika rupa se jari modala ke lie eka naya vishva-rikorda mulya sthapita karana। bikri do sangrahakon ke bicha 28 minata ki gahana boli ladaाee ke bada sanpanna huee, jisamen pisi ne aippala ki 50vin varshagantha varsha ke daurana nilami bloka ko para kara liya।

articles.title: Kapil Sibal criticises government over the removal of Jantar Mantar protest site
articles.summary: Kapil Sibal criticised the central government for denotifying Jantar Mantar as a designated location for public demonstrations. He claimed that the fundamental right to protest is currently under threat and questioned the suitability of alternative venues like Ramlila Maidan. Sibal warned that government tactics against peaceful demonstrators actively undermine the democratic electoral system in the country.
articles.title_hi: कपिल सिब्बल ने जंतर-मंतर विरोध स्थल को हटाने पर सरकार की आलोचना की
articles.summary_hi: कपिल सिब्बल ने जंतर-मंतर को सार्वजनिक प्रदर्शनों के लिए निर्दिष्ट स्थान के रूप में अधिसूचित करने के लिए केंद्र सरकार की आलोचना की। उन्होंने दावा किया कि विरोध करने का मौलिक अधिकार वर्तमान में खतरे में है और उन्होंने रामलीला मैदान जैसे वैकल्पिक स्थानों की उपयुक्तता पर सवाल उठाया। सिब्बल ने चेतावनी दी कि शांतिपूर्ण प्रदर्शनकारियों के खिलाफ सरकार की रणनीति देश में लोकतांत्रिक चुनाव प्रणाली को सक्रिय रूप से कमजोर कर रही है।
articles.title_hinglish: kapila sibbala ne jantara-mantara virodha sthala ko hatane para sarakara ki aalochana ki
articles.summary_hinglish: kapila sibbala ne jantara-mantara ko sarvajanika pradarshanon ke lie nirdishta sthana ke rupa men adhisuchita karane ke lie kendra sarakara ki aalochana ki। unhonne dava kiya ki virodha karane ka maulika adhikara vartamana men khatare men hai aura unhonne ramalila maidana jaise vaikalpika sthanon ki upayuktata para savala uthaya। sibbala ne chetavani di ki shantipurna pradarshanakariyon ke khilapha sarakara ki rananiti desha men lokatantrika chunava pranali ko sakriya rupa se kamajora kara rahi hai।

articles.title: Bhuvneshwar Kumar withdraws from Hong Kong Sixes 2026! RCB Teammate takes over as India
articles.summary: India have made a leadership change ahead of the Hong Kong Sixes 2026, with all-rounder Krunal Pandya appointed captain of the seven-member squad in place of Bhuvneshwar Kumar. Bhuvneshwar has received a call-up to the Indian national team for the upcoming tour of New Zealand, which begins on October 22.

articles.title: Fake Google Chrome app with over 1 lakh downloads found on Google Play: How
articles.summary: A fake version of the Google Chrome browser appeared on the official Google Play Store, displaying over 1 lakh (100,000) downloads and securing a paid “sponsored” placement directly above Google’s genuine browser. The deceptive listing copied Chrome’s official branding, app icon, promotional screenshots and store description, but listed an entirely unrelated entity as its creator.
articles.title_hi: Google Play पर 1 लाख से अधिक डाउनलोड वाला नकली Google Chrome ऐप मिला: कैसे
articles.summary_hi: Google Chrome ब्राउज़र का एक नकली संस्करण आधिकारिक Google Play Store पर दिखाई दिया, जिसमें 1 लाख (100,000) से अधिक डाउनलोड प्रदर्शित हुए और सीधे Google के वास्तविक ब्राउज़र के ऊपर एक सशुल्क "प्रायोजित" प्लेसमेंट प्राप्त हुआ। भ्रामक लिस्टिंग ने क्रोम की आधिकारिक ब्रांडिंग, ऐप आइकन, प्रचार स्क्रीनशॉट और स्टोर विवरण की प्रतिलिपि बनाई, लेकिन इसके निर्माता के रूप में एक पूरी तरह से असंबंधित इकाई को सूचीबद्ध किया।
articles.title_hinglish: Google Play para 1 lakha se adhika daunaloda vala nakali Google Chrome aipa mil: kaise
articles.summary_hinglish: Google Chrome braujara ka eka nakali sanskarana aadhikarika Google Play Store para dikhaee diy, jisamen 1 lakha (100,000) se adhika daunaloda pradarshita hue aura sidhe Google ke vastavika braujara ke oopara eka sashulka "prayojita" plesamenta prapta huaa। bhramaka listinga ne kroma ki aadhikarika branding, aipa aaikan, prachara skrinashota aura stora vivarana ki pratilipi banaee, lekina isake nirmata ke rupa men eka puri taraha se asanbandhita ikaee ko suchibaddha kiya।

articles.title: Astha Kunj park in southeast Delhi remains a persistent crime corridor
articles.summary: At dawn in southeast Delhi, Astha Kunj Udyan offers a peaceful environment for retirees strolling along paths, yoga groups stretching on the grass, and couples meditating. Despite this morning calm, the park functions as a hidden crime corridor that local authorities struggle to fix, according to a report published by The Times of India.
articles.title_hi: दक्षिणपूर्वी दिल्ली का आस्था कुंज पार्क लगातार अपराध का गलियारा बना हुआ है
articles.summary_hi: दक्षिण-पूर्व दिल्ली में भोर के समय, आस्था कुंज उद्यान सेवानिवृत्त लोगों को रास्तों पर टहलते हुए, घास पर योग करते समूहों और ध्यान करते जोड़ों के लिए एक शांतिपूर्ण वातावरण प्रदान करता है। टाइम्स ऑफ इंडिया द्वारा प्रकाशित एक रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, आज सुबह की शांति के बावजूद, पार्क एक छिपे हुए अपराध गलियारे के रूप में कार्य करता है जिसे स्थानीय अधिकारी ठीक करने के लिए संघर्ष कर रहे हैं।
articles.title_hinglish: dakshinapurvi dilli ka aastha kunja parka lagatara aparadha ka galiyara bana huaa hai
articles.summary_hinglish: dakshina-purva dilli men bhora ke samay, aastha kunja udyana sevanivritta logon ko raston para tahalate hue, ghasa para yoga karate samuhon aura dhyana karate jodaोn ke lie eka shantipurna vatavarana pradana karata hai। taimsa ऑpha indiya dvara prakashita eka riporta ke anusar, aaja subaha ki shanti ke bavajud, parka eka chhipe hue aparadha galiyare ke rupa men karya karata hai jise sthaniya adhikari thika karane ke lie sangharsha kara rahe hain।

articles.title: Attempt to Rape: Covering woman’s mouth, lying on her not enough to prove crime
articles.summary: A widow, who is a complainant in the case, was living with her children. On February 8, 2010, a man, the appellant, allegedly entered the house at 10 am , when the woman was asleep, blew out the lamp, lay on top of her and covered the woman's mouth, the prosecution said.

articles.summary_hinglish: kaveri marana ne mananiya mukhyamantri shri e revanta reddi se jubali hilsa sthita unake aavasa para mulakata ki aura unhen apani beti kavya marana ke vivaha samaroha men aamantrita kiya।'' isamen aage kaha gay, ''kavya marana aura aniruddha ravichandara ki shadi ka risepshana 21 navanbara ko chennaee men hone vala hai।
